description:
Giftful: Your Wishlist for Everything

Save everything you want, discover your next favorite find, and share wishlists with the people who matter most.

Giftful is the universal wishlist and shopping companion that lets you save products from any store, organize ideas for every part of your life, compare prices, discover inspiration, and share lists with friends and family. Whether you’re planning your next purchase, creating a holiday wishlist, or building a wedding or baby registry, Giftful keeps everything in one place.

Why You’ll Love Giftful

ONE WISHLIST FOR EVERY STORE
Save products from any online retailer. No more keeping track of dozens of wishlists across different websites.

DISCOVER PRODUCTS YOU’LL LOVE
Browse trending products, curated collections, creator picks, and personalized recommendations. Looking for something specific? Describe what you’re looking for and discover new ideas in seconds.

SHOP SMARTER
Compare prices across retailers and track price changes to help you find the best deal before you buy.

ORGANIZE EVERYTHING YOU WANT
Create unlimited wishlists for fashion, home, tech, travel, hobbies, your kids, holidays, or anything else you’re planning to buy.

SHARE WHEN YOU WANT
Share wishlists with friends and family for birthdays, Christmas, weddings, baby showers, graduations, housewarmings, and other special occasions.

KEEP SURPRISES A SURPRISE
Friends and family can privately claim gifts without the recipient knowing, preventing duplicate purchases while preserving the surprise.

Features

• Universal wishlist that works with virtually any online store
• Add products in seconds from your favorite websites and apps
• Discover products and inspiration with Find Ideas
• Browse trending products, brands, collections, and gift ideas
• Compare prices and track deals across retailers
• Create unlimited wishlists for every part of your life
• Share wishlists with friends and family
• Private gift claiming for birthdays, holidays, and special occasions
• Seamless sync across all your devices
• Beautiful, fast, and easy to use

Whether you're shopping for yourself, planning for the future, or sharing ideas with others, Giftful helps you organize everything you want in one place.

Download Giftful today and join millions of people discovering a better way to shop, save, and share.
